assumptions: #1290 scope is path-item-level parameters only (human-settled fork); $ref resolution, global security and the trace method stay unfixed and the issue stays open (Refs).

#1290 merge semantics follow OpenAPI: an operation parameter with the same name + in overrides the path-level one; a $ref or malformed path-level parameter has no identity, so it is always inherited (unresolved).

#1290 effective parameter order is surviving path-level parameters first, then the operation's own; an operation on a path with no path-level parameters is unchanged, so existing diffs are byte-identical.
#1290 the frozen api-delta vocabulary is unchanged; docs/specs/api-delta-contract.md gains a clarifying paragraph that params compares effective parameters.

#1445 chose degrade-with-notice over fail-fast: an empty token makes RestGitHubClient reject before any fetch and upsertStickyComment degrades with a ::warning:: naming GITHUB_TOKEN, reusing the existing degraded path (verdict printed to log and step summary, exit code = computed verdict).
#1445 the empty-token check is at request time, not in the constructor, so briefing's commentClientFor (which builds the client outside its try) keeps degrading instead of throwing.
